finding.symptom: The onboarding wizard card showed «۵ صفحه» for solar-industry; the library has 24+ solar templates.
finding.source_of_the_number: SiteOnboardingService::wizardOptions(): 'pages' => count($theme->getPageList()), i.e. the master theme row's pages (no pages_count column, no manifest).
finding.production_state: theme 61 pages = 5 (home, about, products, courses, contact); release 7 (1.0.0) snapshot pages = the same 5.
finding.library: 24 solar-industry page templates: 23 content pages (solar-page-*) + auth-solar-industrial (auth canvas), plus solar-header and solar-footer. All classified in policy.json family solar-industry. The customer-site package on production also ships them, so they are available as Canvas library templates on sites with vertical solar_energy and solar_industry_kit.
finding.root_cause: ADR-084 (33a6a459, 2026-11-13) seeded the theme with header, footer and 5 pages. The other 19 templates were added to the library on 2026-11-14 (a4d8773a), but nothing added them to SolarIndustryThemeSeeder::PAGES.
finding.impact: An installed 1.0.0 site gets 5 pages, while the header, footer and pages link to 13 of the missing pages (/page/projects x6, /page/consulting x3, /page/installation, /page/expert-consultation, /page/design, ...), which would 404.

rollout.step_1: php artisan theme-catalog:rebuild --slug=solar-industry (as www-data in /var/www/saas-platform): reseeds the existing theme 61 in place with 24 pages; the marketplace listing and price are kept (release 282 rule); no delete.
rollout.step_2: Theme Builder «انتشار» for solar-industry with version 1.1.0 (ThemeBuilderService::publish): a new release through the Mandatory Publish Gate. New installations push 1.1.0 (24 pages).
rollout.existing_sites: Sites on 1.0.0 upgrade in «قالب‌های من ← ارتقا» (ThemeUpgradeReconciler: remote-only pages are added as page_added; the site's own edits are preserved). No site needs to be deleted. At the time of writing no customer site is installed with solar-industry (all solar installations were rolled back).
